product_title: Handcrafted Shubh Labh Lotus Door Hanging
product_description: Bring traditional elegance and auspicious charm to your home with this handcrafted Shubh Labh lotus door hanging. Featuring a vibrant pink lotus motif, a red centerpiece with golden Shubh Labh lettering, elegant pearl embellishments, black-and-gold detailing, and delicate pearl tassels, this decorative piece beautifully complements Indian festive decor. Perfect for adorning main doors, pooja rooms, entranceways, and living spaces during Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid water, moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals to protect the colours and embellishments.
Keep away from direct sunlight to help maintain the vibrant pink and red colours.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling or breakage.
Store in a dry, dust-free box when not in use to preserve the decorative elements and maintain its shape.
